name: StreamLens HUD — VR Streamer Chat Alerts
summary:
StreamLens VR is the premier spatial streamer heads-up display engineered for Meta Horizon OS creators. Monitor your live chat, celebrate subs and donations, trigger stream sound effects, and engage with your community—without ever leaving your immersive VR games or creative worlds.

Engineered by 24Bit System with zero-latency client-side architecture and zero hardware requirements.
